Senior Backend Engineer

Acme Robotics is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build and operate the fleet-orchestration services that coordinate thousands of warehouse robots in real time.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production backend systems in Node.js or a similar runtime
- Strong experience designing distributed systems, with an understanding of consistency, back-pressure and failure modes
- Solid grasp of observability and operating services in production
- Excellent written communication

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kubernetes
- Prior work in robotics or logistics

You will mentor junior engineers and own features end to end.

Frontend Engineer (React)

Nimbus Analytics is looking for a Frontend Engineer to build our real-time dashboards.

Requirements:
- 3+ years with React and TypeScript
- Experience with data visualisation
- Comfortable working with streaming data APIs

Bonus points for experience with WebSockets and D3.

Platform Engineer

We need a Platform Engineer with strong Kubernetes and Terraform experience and 4+ years operating cloud infrastructure.

Data Engineer

Nimbus Analytics needs a Data Engineer with 4+ years in streaming data (Kafka or similar), strong SQL, and Python. Must be comfortable owning pipelines end to end. Nice to have: dbt, Airflow.
